findings.explanation: Your payment depends on an indefinite, client-controlled or third-party event (receiving a tax exemption approval), meaning you could experience indefinite payment delays without it being considered a breach.
findings.suggested_change: Payments shall be made within the agreed timeframe regardless of whether tax exemption approvals have been received, subject to standard statutory withholding tax requirements.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the contract. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a minor adjustment to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause ("For avoidance of doubt, payments will be made only after receiving exemption from tax deduction approval from the tax authority in Israel. Delay in payment as a result of not receiving such exemption will not constitute late payment or breach hereunder."), as my compensation depends on an indefinite external event, I could experience indefinite payment delays without it being considered a breach. Therefore, I propose the following constructive modification: Payments shall be made within the agreed timeframe regardless of whether tax exemption approvals have been received, subject to standard statutory withholding tax requirements. Best regards,
